title: Reconcile conflicting technical claims
prompt: Research whether SWE-bench Verified results can be compared directly across model providers. Gather the benchmark's own description and at least two provider evaluation reports. Explain differences in harness, number of attempts, scaffolding, and known benchmark limitations. If sources make claims that appear to conflict, quote or summarize the relevant evidence, attribute each claim, and explain whether the difference is actually due to a different setup.
requested_dimensions: Evidence-based resolution or explicit unresolved conflict
acceptance_criteria: Benchmark definition is sourced from the benchmark authors or official materials
Provider claims are attributed to their own technical reports
Different evaluation setups are not presented as directly equivalent
Conflicts are surfaced rather than averaged away
The conclusion separates evidence from interpretation
